THE discriminator: stripping the gate must strictly increase the 19.8 atkPct application count, and the FIRST rupee burst cast must precede the first grant (the opening cast is gated out) — fails under an ungated burstCast rider that over-credits the team on every rotation.
Painted set size === full comp size and includes rupee (no excludeSelf); removing the effect lowers at least one teammate, proving the rider is a real cross-unit carrier.

fixtures: controlComp('rupee', true) for every group. rupee is Burst II, so B1 + a B3 are required for the chain to complete and bursts to actually cast — the fixed-B3 flag stays true. The control comp is mixed-element, which is what makes the skill1 'Iron Code allies' scope assertion discriminating (a whole-team model paints non-Iron slugs). Deterministic, no seed. Counterfactuals are all in-memory withPatchedOverride clones; the committed JSON is never touched. Runs are hoisted: 1 baseline + 6 counterfactual runs = 7 full 180s sims, well under the ~20-run budget.
gaps: skill1 'Increases stack count of buffs by 1' — it.skip: no engine primitive exists to raise another buff's stack count or maxStacks. The effect schema has no such EffectDef kind, and stacks are owned by the individual buff instance. Unobservable payload; belongs in unmodeled.skill1.
